socialchamp.name: Social Champ
socialchamp.tagline: Post once and show up everywhere from one social media workspace
socialchamp.desc: Social Champ brings publishing, analytics, engagement, listening, collaboration, and AI tools into one workspace for managing multiple social channels. Agencies and teams can plan campaigns, coordinate approvals, answer conversations, and report on performance across 12+ platforms.
socialchamp.best: Agencies, social media teams and growing brands managing multi-platform publishing, approvals, engagement and reporting from one workspace
features: Multi-platform Publishing — Draft once, tailor posts by network and schedule content across 12+ social platforms
Content Calendar — Plan campaigns in list, week, month or grid views and share calendars with clients
Teams and Approvals — Separate brands into workspaces and route content through structured multi-level approval workflows
Analytics and Reporting — Compare cross-platform performance and export client-ready PDF and presentation reports
Unified Social Inbox — Manage comments, direct messages and reviews from a shared team queue
Champ AI Suite — Generate captions, images and hashtags that follow the brand’s voice

socialbee.name: SocialBee
socialbee.tagline: Create, schedule and improve a month of social content from one workspace
socialbee.desc: SocialBee is an all-in-one social media management platform for creating, scheduling, analyzing, and engaging across multiple networks. Its category-based calendar, evergreen recycling, AI creation, collaboration, and reporting tools help teams keep a balanced publishing rhythm without juggling separate apps.
socialbee.best: Freelancers, small businesses and agencies creating, scheduling and measuring a consistent multi-platform content mix
features: AI Content Creation — Generate on-brand captions and visuals, then customize each post for the destination network
Category-based Scheduling — Organize posts into content categories and automatically publish a balanced mix from one calendar
Evergreen Recycling — Requeue high-performing posts, add variations and expire time-sensitive content automatically
Social Media Analytics — Track reach, engagement, growth and top content, then generate shareable PDF reports
Unified Engagement — Reply to comments, mentions and direct messages from supported networks in one inbox
Team Collaboration — Separate clients into workspaces, assign roles and manage feedback and approvals beside each post
